title: Ada and the Letter Again
author: Cyrus Thackeray
blurb: Felix Quintana, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
